title: The Deep Asset
author: Lena Kavanagh
blurb: Coral Ravensworth, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
